subject: ist-pt
title: IST.PT.------MN.DI.
description: Diagram closing R(AS)CM(II)-8 — the section on transformation as 'making available what is available.' The prose above the diagram identifies the structural target: 'the move to expose composite creativity is a move to positively reshape society — for all people — and this must be the goal of positive transformation.' The crossing diagrams the structural mechanism by which expose-composite-creativity actually meets its political-particular conditions: (C)IST-PT (the concept of isolated particulars) is crossed with MN-DI (mono-dimensional). No label MN-DI is drawn; the main line runs from IST-PT, at the right with the subject-arrow, up to a label drawn MN-DU. OP-SD (option spread) branches from the main line, and POST (postulation) from OP-SD. (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) branches from the main line and runs to the left; SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) branches from it, P-PROG (particular progressionalism) from SOC-RT-DY, and POL-P (political policies) from P-PROG. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) also branches from the INTR line; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and TR-DIF (trans-definition) branch from T-C-IMP, and RET-AF-TD (retrograde affinity tendencies) from RT-ALGN.
